beats.text: OpenAI claims its AI just settled a famous question about pi.
Twenty-two sevenths is close. Three fifty-five over one thirteen is closer.
The claim: past some size, no fraction beats exponent two.
Two is the lowest possible, so pi is as hard to approximate as it gets.
It implies the Flint-Hills series converges.
Status: an OpenAI claim, not peer reviewed. Lean files published, not checked by us.
Follow for more, and see how everything works.
